title: Oldest Figurative Art Discovered
content: The Smithsonian says: "This painting of a cattle-like animal in a Borneo cave has been dated at at least 40,000 years old, making it the oldest-known figurative rock art in the world." (Image via: Luc-Henri Fage)----Read more:World’s Oldest-Known Figurative Paintings Discovered in Borneo Cave
